entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. I just need the return authorization.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF89-6754. Look, is this going to take long? I just need a yes or no on the return.
I understand you're busy. I just need to ask one quick question to process this correctly. What specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. The color wasn't what I expected. The box is still unopened. It has nothing to do with safety or a defect, I just want to send it back.
Understood. Thank you for clarifying. One moment while I pull up your order VF89-6754.
Okay, I see the order for the Urban Commuter Helmet. It looks like it was delivered 52 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Alright, you're all set. According to our system, standard items are eligible for return within 90 days. Since you're at 52 days, you are well within the window.
Yes, I've just approved the return. I'm sending the email with the pre-paid shipping label and instructions to you right now. You should see it in your inbox within the next 5-10 minutes.
Finally. Okay, that's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
